name: FLY: Forever Loving You (2)
source:
It is the beginning of a new school term, welcome to your first year in high school!
Play a high school girl starting a new year. Between friendship, love, secrets and revelations, will you be able to keep the promise you made before the summer holidays?

[Translated from [url=https://ajeb.itch.io/fly2]Ich.io[/url]]

FLY: Forever Loving You (2) is a sequel and a reboot of [url=/v31232]FLY: Forever Loving You[/url] which was the creator's first project. Unsatisfied with the result as he had a hard time learning how to juggle between drawing, programming and writing, he decided to start over with this new project.
It is not needed to have read the first installment as the important points will be reminded.
translation:
新学期开始，欢迎来到高中一年级！
扮演一名开启新学年的高中女生。在友谊、爱情、秘密与真相揭晓之间，你能否守住暑假前许下的承诺？

[译自[url=https://ajeb.itch.io/fly2]itch.io[/url]]

《FLY: Forever Loving You (2)》既是[url=/v31232]《FLY: Forever Loving You》[/url]的续作，也是重启之作。前作是作者的首个项目。当时，他还在艰难学习如何兼顾绘画、编程与写作，对成品并不满意，因此决定以这个新项目重新开始。
即使没有读过第一作也没关系，游戏会重新交代重要内容。
